fee_notes: Standard initial franchise fee is $45,000 for a territory containing up to 60,000 SFDUs. Reduced fee of $27,000 is available for eligible participants in the Industry Associate Program. Additional fee of $0.50 per SFDU over 60,000 SFDUs applies if a larger territory is approved. VetFran Program participants (veterans) receive up to $5,000 applied to start-up expenses (not available to Industry Associate Program participants). Financing options available: $30,000 due at signing, remaining $15,000 may be financed over 5 years under SpringGreen Franchise Fee Financing. Additional initial franchise fees are required for each additional Territory acquired.
raw_excerpt: To acquire a franchise for a Franchised Business you must pay an initial franchise fee of $45,000 for a geographic territory containing up to 60,000 single family dwelling units ("SFDUs"). However, if you elect, and are eligible, to participate in the Industry Associate Program, you will pay a reduced initial franchise fee in the amount of $27,000 for a geographic territory containing up to 60,000 SFDUs. If you wish to obtain a geographic territory of more than 60,000 SFDUs, and we approve, you must pay us an additional fee of $0.50 for each SFDU over 60,000 SFDUs, even if you are eligible to participate in the Industry Associate Program.
